run_connect_watcher: run the connect watcher to monitor sys_connect syscall latency and print process connection timing
create_comm_timing_structure: create a CommTiming ctypes structure to store process name, elapsed time, pid, and raw address
create_connect_start_structure: create a ConnectStart ctypes structure to track socket connection start time and address family
get_pretty_addr_raw: get a human-readable address string from raw bytes supporting AF_UNIX, AF_INET, and AF_INET6
review_kprobe_connect_tracing: review the kprobe-based sys_connect entry and exit probe tracing setup for connection latency measurement
